drills.name: Passing Diamond
drills.description: Four players form a diamond shape and pass the ball around with one touch
drills.setup: Place 4 cones in a diamond shape, 10 yards apart. One player on each cone.
drills.objective: Improve passing accuracy and movement off the ball

drills.name: One Touch Wall Passing
drills.description: Pass the ball to the rebounder or wall with one touch. Make sure to alternate feet with each pass.
drills.setup: Find a wall or rebounder and pass the ball from about 4-5 feet away.
drills.reps: 5 minutes with both feet, or 2.5 minutes with each foot
drills.objective: Improve passing accuracy and ball control

drills.name: Two Touch Wall Passing
drills.description: Recieve the ball with your foot and touch it across to the other and then pass the ball to the rebounder or wall.
drills.setup: Find a wall or rebounder and pass the ball from about 4-5 feet away.
drills.objective: Improve passing accuracy and ball control

drills.name: Cone Wall Passing (One Touch)
drills.description: Pass the ball to the rebounder or wall with one touch diagonally. Move to the other side of the cone and repeat. Make sure to alternate feet with each pass.
drills.setup: Find a wall or rebounder and pass the ball from about 4-5 feet away. Place a cone about 1-2 feet away from the wall.
drills.objective: Improve passing accuracy and ball control

drills.name: Cone Wall Passing (Two Touch)
drills.description: Pass the ball to the rebounder or wall diagonally. Move to the other side of the cone, recieve, and repeat. Make sure to alternate feet with each pass.
drills.setup: Find a wall or rebounder and pass the ball from about 4-5 feet away. Place a cone about 1-2 feet away from the wall.
drills.objective: Improve passing accuracy and ball control

drills.name: Juggling
drills.description: Juggle the ball in the air using both feet. Try not to let the ball drop.
drills.setup: Find an open space and a ball.
drills.objective: Improves ball control, first touch, and your weak foot.

drills.name: Wall Juggling
drills.description: Juggle the ball in the air using both feet. Pass the ball to the wall so it comes back to you. Try not to let the ball drop.
drills.setup: Find an open space with a wall and a ball.
drills.objective: Improves ball control, first touch, passing in the air, and your weak foot.

drills.name: Receiving Turn
drills.description: Pass the ball against the rebounder then receive and turn with the ball and then explode with the ball. Try not to turn to close to the cone or too far.
drills.setup: Find an open space with a rebounder. Place a cone 8-10 feet away from the rebounder. Stand about 1 foot in front of the cone.
drills.reps: 3 sets of 15 reps for each foot.
drills.objective: Improves passing, first touch, recieving, and your weak foot.

drills.name: 1v1 Shielding Drill
drills.description: One player shields the ball while the other tries to win it
drills.setup: Mark a 5x5 yard box with cones. Attacker shields inside, defender outside.
drills.objective: Improve body positioning and ball protection under pressure

drills.name: Cone Dribbling Course
drills.description: Dribble through a line of cones as fast as possible with close control
drills.setup: Place 8 cones in a straight line, 1 yard apart.
drills.reps: 10 runs, alternating left and right foot
drills.objective: Improve close ball control and weak foot ability

drills.name: Finishing Under Pressure
drills.description: Striker receives a pass and must shoot before a defender closes them down
drills.setup: Striker starts 20 yards from goal. Feeder passes the ball. Defender starts 5 yards behind.
drills.objective: Improve composure and decision making in front of goal

drills.name: Defensive Shape Drill
drills.description: Defensive unit holds their shape while attackers try to find gaps
drills.setup: 3 defenders vs 3 attackers in half pitch. Defenders must stay compact.
drills.objective: Improve defensive communication and positional awareness

drills.name: First Touch Control
drills.description: Player receives balls from different heights and angles and controls with one touch
drills.setup: Two players face each other 10 yards apart. Server throws or kicks varied balls.
drills.objective: Improve first touch in all directions

drills.name: Pressing Trigger Drill
drills.description: Team presses immediately after losing the ball to win it back quickly
drills.setup: 4v2 in a 15x15 yard box. When possession is lost, both players press immediately.
drills.objective: Improve pressing triggers and high intensity defending

drills.name: Weak Foot Passing Wall
drills.description: Player passes against a wall repeatedly using only their weak foot
drills.setup: Stand 5 yards from a wall. Pass and control on the rebound.
drills.objective: Build confidence and accuracy with the weak foot

drills.name: Figure 8 (Right)
drills.description: Player passes against a wall repeatedly using only their weak foot
drills.setup: Stand 5 yards from a wall. Pass and control on the rebound.
drills.objective: Build confidence and accuracy with the weak foot

drills.name: Passing Gates Challenge
drills.description: Two players pass the ball through different cone gates while moving to new passing angles.
drills.setup: Create 4 cone gates, each 2 yards wide, inside a 15x15 yard area. Position two players with one ball.
drills.objective: Improve passing accuracy, weight of pass, and movement into open passing lanes

drills.name: First Touch Escape Gates
drills.description: Receive a pass and use the first touch to guide the ball through an open cone gate.
drills.setup: Place 3 cone gates around the receiving player. Position a passing partner 8 yards away.
drills.objective: Improve directional first touch and control into open space

drills.name: Inside Outside Dribbling
drills.description: Move the ball forward using alternating inside and outside touches with the same foot.
drills.setup: Create a 15 yard straight channel using cones. Start at one end with the ball.
drills.objective: Improve close control, foot coordination, and dribbling rhythm

drills.name: Lateral Ball Roll Mastery
drills.description: Use the sole of each foot to roll the ball laterally while moving across a marked area.
drills.setup: Create a 5x5 yard square with cones and start in the center.
drills.objective: Improve sole control, coordination, and close ball manipulation

drills.name: Target Shooting
drills.description: Shoot toward designated target zones in the goal using both feet.
drills.setup: Place 4 target markers inside the goal. Position balls 12 yards from the goal.
drills.objective: Improve shooting accuracy, technique, and finishing consistency

drills.name: One Touch Passing Triangle
drills.description: Three players pass the ball around a triangle using one touch while maintaining proper body positioning.
drills.setup: Arrange 3 cones in a triangle, 8 yards apart. Position one player at each cone.
drills.objective: Improve quick passing, body orientation, and decision-making

drills.name: Scanning Before Receiving
drills.description: A receiving player checks their surroundings before receiving a pass and plays toward the indicated target.
drills.setup: Position one receiver in the center and two passing players 10 yards apart. Use colored cones as directional targets.
drills.objective: Improve visual scanning, spatial awareness, and decision-making before receiving the ball

drills.name: Defensive Positioning Shadow Drill
drills.description: A defender mirrors an attacking player's movements while maintaining appropriate defensive distance and body positioning.
drills.setup: Create a 10x10 yard square. Position the attacker and defender facing each other.
drills.objective: Improve defensive positioning, lateral movement, and reaction speed

drills.name: One Versus One Attacking
drills.description: An attacker attempts to beat a defender and dribble through one of two scoring gates.
drills.setup: Create a 15x12 yard area with two cone gates at the opposite end.
drills.reps: 4 sets of 5 attacking attempts per player
drills.objective: Develop confidence in one-on-one situations, change of direction, and attacking decisions

drills.name: Off Ball Movement Gates
drills.description: Players move into open passing lanes and receive passes through designated cone gates.
drills.setup: Create a 20x20 yard area with 4 passing gates. Position three players inside the area.
drills.objective: Improve movement off the ball, passing angles, and spatial awareness

drills.name: Rondo Four Versus One
drills.description: Four attacking players maintain possession while one defender attempts to intercept the ball.
drills.setup: Create a 10x10 yard square. Position four attackers around the outside and one defender inside.
drills.reps: 5 sets of 3 minutes with rotating defenders
drills.objective: Improve quick passing, possession retention, scanning, and decision-making under pressure

drills.name: First Touch Directional Control
drills.description: Receive a pass and use the first touch to move the ball toward a designated direction before returning it.
drills.setup: Place 4 colored cones around the receiving player. Position the passing partner 10 yards away.
drills.objective: Improve directional first touch, body positioning, and control into open space

drills.name: Quick Release Shooting
drills.description: Receive a pass near the penalty area and shoot within two touches.
drills.setup: Position a feeder 15 yards from goal and a shooter near the edge of the penalty area.
drills.objective: Improve shooting speed, finishing accuracy, and composure under time pressure

drills.name: Defensive Recovery Runs
drills.description: A defender starts behind an attacker and sprints to recover defensive positioning before the attacker reaches the scoring zone.
drills.setup: Create a 25 yard channel with a scoring gate at one end. Position the defender 5 yards behind the attacker.
drills.objective: Improve recovery speed, defensive angles, and positioning during transitions

drills.name: Two Versus One Decision Making
drills.description: Two attackers attempt to beat one defender by choosing between passing, dribbling, or shooting.
drills.setup: Create a 20x15 yard attacking area with a small goal at one end.
drills.objective: Improve attacking decisions, timing of passes, and recognition of defensive gaps

drills.name: Advanced Rondo Five Versus Two
drills.description: Five attackers maintain possession against two defenders using a maximum of two touches.
drills.setup: Create a 12x12 yard square. Position five attackers around the area and two defenders inside.
drills.reps: 5 sets of 3 minutes with defender rotation
drills.objective: Improve possession under pressure, rapid decision-making, and awareness of passing options

drills.name: Third Man Passing Combination
drills.description: Three players execute a passing sequence where the third player makes a timed run to receive the final pass.
drills.setup: Arrange 3 cones in a triangle, 12 yards apart. Position one player at each cone.
drills.objective: Improve combination play, timing of runs, and awareness of third-man passing opportunities

drills.name: Pressing and Defensive Cover
drills.description: Two defenders coordinate pressing and covering movements against two attackers attempting to maintain possession.
drills.setup: Create a 20x15 yard area. Position two attackers with one ball and two defenders opposite them.
drills.reps: 5 sets of 3 minutes with role rotation
drills.objective: Improve coordinated pressing, defensive communication, and cover positioning

drills.name: Transition Attack and Recovery
drills.description: Teams immediately switch between attacking and defending after possession changes.
drills.setup: Create a 30x20 yard field with two small goals. Divide six players into two teams of three.
drills.objective: Improve reaction to possession changes, counterattacking decisions, and defensive recovery

drills.name: Pressure Finishing Challenge
drills.description: An attacker receives a pass under defensive pressure and must create a shooting opportunity within three seconds.
drills.setup: Position a feeder outside the penalty area, an attacker near the penalty spot, and a defender behind the attacker.
drills.objective: Improve finishing under pressure, quick decision-making, and composure in attacking situations
